subject: MAP kickoff: POC environment — org seed, API keys, IP allowlist & VPC peering
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Park <sam@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-18 09:12 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: POC environment — org seed, API keys, IP allowlist & VPC peering

Hi Sam — great to meet on the call yesterday. As discussed, I put together a lean mutual action plan (MAP) to get HelioHealth a short POC running against our hosted infra so you can validate latency/cost and the org/bootstrap flow. High-level asks from your side: org account seed, list of IPs for allowlisting, and a service account with permission to pull logs for troubleshooting (we'll provide the template).

Proposed 2-week close path:
- Day 0–2: Org creation + API key provisioning (Helio action + Redwood confirm)
- Day 3–5: IP allowlist and ephemeral key test (network team)
- Day 6–9: VPC peering test (if you opt for peering) or proxy routing verification
- Day 10–14: Smoke tests, performance checkpoint, and evaluation wrap-up

I attached a small playbook and the allowlist template to make the handoff quick. Can you confirm:
1) the right point-of-contact for org creation and network?
2) whether you want VPC peering or prefer to use our routed proxy for the proof?

If you confirm POC start Monday 8/18, we can hit the timeline above.

Cheers,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
attachments: 20250818_MAP_POC_Playbook.xlsx (xlsx), network-allowlist-template.txt (txt)

From: Sam Park <sam@heliohealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-18 10:01 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: POC environment — org seed, API keys, IP allowlist & VPC peering

Thanks Jonas — this looks good and aligned with what we need. I'll be the primary POC owner for the Helio side and will loop in Alyssa from infra for the network bits. Quick answers:
- POC start: Monday 8/18 works.
- Network: we prefer VPC peering if you support it with a simple NAT setup; otherwise proxy is fine for the first pass.
- POC contact: Alyssa Gomez (aws infra) and myself. I'll share her contact and the team roster by EOD.

Please go ahead and share the minimal IAM template and the API key provisioning instructions — we'll aim to finish org seed + initial keys within 48 hours.

Best,
Sam Park
Product Lead, Integrations | HelioHealth

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Cc: Sam Park <sam@heliohealth.com>
Date: 2025-08-18 11:05 -0700
Subject: Internal: Helio POC MAP — task split and timeline

Neha/Karthik — following Sam's confirmation, here's how I propose we split work for the next 48 hours:
- Neha: prepare org-seed docs, IAM template, and the API key provisioning steps. Attach the quick-start script for ephemeral token rotation.
- Karthik: prep VPC peering checklist and the proxy-fallback runbook (in case peering is delayed). Also validate our firewall/NAT requirements and produce a minimal SG/ACL spec to send to Helio.

I'll send the playbook (attached) and the allowlist template to Sam/Alyssa; please review the templates and add any constraints by EOD. We want their org seeded and first API key validated within 48 hours to stay on the MAP timeline.

Thanks — Jonas

attachments: 20250818_MAP_POC_Playbook.xlsx (xlsx), network-allowlist-template.txt (txt)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Park <sam@heliohealth.com>, Alyssa Gomez <alyssa.gomez@heliohealth.com>
Date: 2025-08-18 17:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Helio POC MAP — task split and timeline

Thanks Jonas — draft IAM & API steps below and I attached a tightened playbook with checkboxes. Key notes for Helio infra team:
- Org seed: create an org admin user and a service account named "helio-poc-connector". Grant the service account read/log-download to the POC project only.
- API key provisioning: Use the API console flow in the playbook. We'll issue a scoped key (read + generate only) — do not use broad admin keys.
- Ephemeral token rotation: rotate every 4 hours for the POC run; script included.

Network items for Alyssa (cc'd):
- Please provide the public IP CIDR(s) you will originate calls from (or let us know if you want to do VPC peering).
- If peering: share the VPC CIDR and preferred peering account ID. We'll coordinate cross-account route tables.

Attachments: updated_playbook_checklist.xlsx, network-allowlist-template.txt

Jonas / Neha — quick update from infra:
- We will provide VPC CIDR: 10.42.0.0/16 and peer account id: 123456789012.
- Public egress CIDRs for initial tests: 34.201.12.0/24, 52.23.45.0/24 (we'll confirm exact ranges tomorrow).
- We validated your allowlist template and updated it with our expected ephemeral IPs (see attached network-allowlist-template.txt).

Next steps from our side:
1) Sam to create the org admin and service account by EOD tomorrow (8/21).
2) Once Jonas confirms peering window, Alyssa will schedule the peering change (we prefer a 2-hour maintenance window early morning).

Thanks — looking forward to the POC.

Alyssa Gomez
Cloud Infrastructure Lead | HelioHealth
